record.body: Repair: tests for the verify path miss the worktree layout and several validation edges. No test runs aff check or close-batch from a phase worktree with --cwd against a store in the primary checkout; reverting build_batch(request, cwd=args.cwd) and mutating the aff check --cwd wiring both pass. Add those tests, plus the 10 real_gap mutant survivors in spikes/llm-mutants/findings.md (missing result treated as pass, missing check_run_id, dirty green vs SHA red, missing green revision, timeout mapped to fail, empty verify_command).
